blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Former Senate Sergeant-at-Arms Mao Ranada Aplasca on Wednesday submitted his counter-affidavit to the direct assault complaint before the Department of Justice (DOJ) in connection with the May 13 incident that led to gunshots being fired in the chamber. DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez confirmed that Aplasca filed his counter-affidavit as one of three respondents in the complaint lodged by the Philippine National Police’s (PNP) Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG). The two other members of the Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms (OSSA), who are his co-respondents, have already submitted their counter-affidavits.
